about.title: About Me
about.description: I am an enthusiastic and adaptable Full Stack Developer with hands-on experience in building responsive and scalable web applications using the MERN stack. I enjoy turning real-world problems into clean, functional, and user-friendly digital solutions. I am constantly learning, experimenting, and improving my skills to become a better engineer every day.
about.quote: Learning by building, growing by solving.
highlights: Hands-on experience with MERN stack development
Strong foundation in frontend and backend technologies
Experience building real-world dashboards and systems
Quick learner with strong problem-solving skills

objective.title: Career Objective
objective.content: To begin my professional journey as a Full Stack Developer where I can apply my MERN stack skills, problem-solving abilities, and passion for technology to build scalable applications, gain industry exposure, and grow as a software engineer.

profileSummary.title: Profile Summary
profileSummary.content: Motivated Full Stack Developer with practical experience in React.js, Node.js, Express.js, and MongoDB. Skilled in developing secure, responsive, and user-centric applications. Experienced in building dashboards, authentication systems, and REST APIs. A collaborative team player with a strong desire to learn and grow in fast-paced development environments.

roles: Developed a MERN stack web application to showcase IOCL Barauni’s current and upcoming projects
Built a responsive frontend using React with Vite
Integrated backend APIs to handle dynamic project data and news updates
Implemented a secure login-based dashboard for authenticated users
Ensured cross-browser compatibility and responsive design
Developed full-stack web applications using React.js, Node.js, Express.js, and MongoDB
Implemented JWT-based authentication for secure user access
Optimized API performance and database queries for scalability
Collaborated with team members to deliver features on time
